method: For each D in the requested date list where archive[D] and archive[D-30] both exist, compare archive[D].per_ticker[ticker].yfinance.fields.eps_trend.records[period]['30daysAgo'] (the lookback side) against archive[D-30]...records[period]['current'] (the actual side). relative_deviation = (lookback - actual) / actual. This script issues no pass/fail verdict.

universe.note: verifiable_tickers = tickers whose D-N archive side was usable in at least one date pair; tickers_without_lookback_history = current-universe tickers with no usable archive 30 days before any tested D (universe expanded after the early archive window). Their absence is a history-length fact, not a data-quality verdict.

30d.reason: archive[D-30] must exist; archive coverage starts at 2026-07-12, so the earliest D with both sides present is 2026-07-12 + 30 days = 2026-08-11.

full_universe.reason: the archive only holds the full constituent universe from 2026-07-24 onward (measured on disk), so a full-universe 30-day validation first becomes possible at 2026-07-24 + 30 days = 2026-08-23; earlier D values validate only the early smaller universe.

60d.reason: archive[D-60] must exist; archive coverage starts at 2026-07-12, so the earliest D with both sides present is 2026-07-12 + 60 days = 2026-09-10.

full_universe.reason: the archive only holds the full constituent universe from 2026-07-24 onward (measured on disk), so a full-universe 60-day validation first becomes possible at 2026-07-24 + 60 days = 2026-09-22; earlier D values validate only the early smaller universe.

90d.reason: archive[D-90] must exist; archive coverage starts at 2026-07-12, so the earliest D with both sides present is 2026-07-12 + 90 days = 2026-10-10.

full_universe.reason: the archive only holds the full constituent universe from 2026-07-24 onward (measured on disk), so a full-universe 90-day validation first becomes possible at 2026-07-24 + 90 days = 2026-10-22; earlier D values validate only the early smaller universe.
